title: Engineering Rules
desc: The design-docs/engineering-rules router and what each rule set covers.
lede: The repo encodes its conventions as engineering rules, so every contributor follows the same constraints.
body:
At a glance
  • A rules router maps tasks to rule sets.
  • Key constraints like modular architecture.
  • Verification before calling work “done.”

The router

A rules file routes a task to the relevant rule sets (backend boundaries, frontend, paths, workflow, and more).

Key constraints

Modular architecture and clear boundaries are enforced, and changes aren't “done” until verified. See Testing & Verification.
